title: Map a supplied function structurally
specification:
def Spec (f : (Nat → Nat) → List Nat → List Nat) : Prop :=
  ∀ g xs, f g xs = xs.map g
signature: (g : Nat → Nat) (xs : List Nat) : List Nat
constraints: Use only the supplied Std import.
Return an expression body and a proof term; do not add global declarations.
Use a local structurally recursive function.
